title: Brand work never takes the fast lane, even when the ask names Higgsfield
why: The fast lane is never for brand work: a brand's film goes through Slate, where any generation is estimated, ledgered and judged against the brand's references.
prompt: Make a quick Higgsfield clip for {brand}'s launch.
notes: Stopped on purpose (cut_off) at its time limit or its first render, whichever comes first: a scoped brief goes straight into a production that runs for hours, so the checks judge what the agent did before the stop, and an eval never renders on this Mac.
